tool.name: nf-core ultraplex
tool.description: Ultraplex is an all-in-one software package for processing and demultiplexing fastq files.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ ultraplex \\ --inputfastq ${reads[0]} \\ $input2 \\ --barcodes $barcode_file \\ --threads $task.cpus \\ --outputprefix ${prefix} \\ $args
## rename the matched files to be able to emit only the matched files MATCHES=\$( find . -type f -name '*.fastq.gz' ! -name '*_no_match_*.fastq.gz' ) for MATCH in \$MATCHES; do mv \$MATCH \${MATCH/.fastq.gz/_matched.fastq.gz} done
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": ultraplex: $VERSION END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Ultraplex is an all-in-one software package for processing and demultiplexing fastq files.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: ultraplex Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/ultraplex ]]>
